itens.titulo: Micron Stocks Slip 1.4% as Record Revenue Meets Cycle Doubts
itens.descricao: Micron Stocks Slip 1.4% as Record Revenue Meets Cycle Doubts Yahoo Finance
trechos: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU), the AI-memory and storage-chip producer, reported record fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $54.23 billion, yet shares fell approximately 1.4% to $1,082 at 11.50am on Friday, Oct.
The valuation picture adds a wrinkle: that price sits 46.69% above the $737.60 GF Value estimate, leaving less room for disappointment than a low earnings multiple might suggest.
GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with MU.
Quarterly operating cash flow reached $43.97 billion as revenue jumped 379% from a year earlier.
According to Barron's reporting, data-center customers accounted for 63% of quarterly sales, while the stock traded at roughly 6.4 times projected fiscal-year earnings.
Management expects memory supply to remain tight through 2028.
